classification: Local Node and actual workerd with genuine signed fixture wallets; financial execution disabled

commands.command: focused transport, legacy collect and contract tests

commands.scope: Includes two separate uncommitted041 observation evidence tests; CI verifies exact committed scope.

assertions: Mounted Node and Worker share strict transport and real repositories; old public unreviewed progression fallback removed.
Quote POST requires stable idempotency key; accepted replay retains original binding, quote ID, outcome and expiry.
Reservation requires all reviewed immutable quote fields; actual wallet ownership, current versions, clock and operating controls rechecked.
Actual signed-wallet cross-runtime test covers simultaneous duplicate requests, mismatched terms, another wallet, pause/replay, invalid origin/header/body and expired sessions.
HTTP rejects request-injected inventory/key/authority/clock and bounded numeric overflow without masking internal errors.
Successful reservation returns original operation, quote ID and binding; UI checks exact response identity before clearing the unknown request.
limitations: Collection read routes remain Node-only until separately ported.
Synthetic sources and local locking establish no chain custody or execution authority.
041 observations, normalized stage/mint authority, atomic fulfillment and larger recovery capacity remain unfinished.
